pos_neg_margin_category_breakdown.category_breakdown_reason: Item categories are unavailable in this task

export_parity.reason: An explicit category route and eligible prefix are required

metrics.four_category_macro_reason: One category view per invocation; all four category user means are required

metric_definitions.embedding_collapse_score: (Mean off-diagonal cosine + 1)/2 on up to 2048 nonpadding item embeddings, seed 42. Near 0.5 indicates near-zero average cosine, not failure. Measures directional alignment, not rank collapse or recommendation diversity. Null with fewer than two items.
metric_definitions.embedding_sample_count: Number of sampled nonpadding embeddings; pair denominator is k*(k-1).
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_mean: Mean positive-minus-negative logit over finite, nonpadding sequence/positive/negative positions in at most ten loader batches. Scale depends on embedding norms.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_p10: Nearest-rank 10th percentile of the same valid training margins.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_neg_beats_pos_rate: Fraction of those valid positions with margin below zero; not sampled-candidate HR@10.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_small_margin_rate: Fraction of those valid positions with margin below 0.5; this threshold is score-scale dependent.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_category_breakdown: Contains valid-position counts and empty category lists: item categories are unavailable.
metric_definitions.contract_controls: Structural offsets compose both convolutions in every residual block. Readout tests include short left-padded histories. Causality tests compare intermediate positions in independent disposable copies with dropout disabled and identical initial buffers. Copies retain trained parameters but use only the three embedding rows exercised by controls. Synthetic boundary controls use disposable weights. Observed contract failures block sensitivity summaries; absent export parity limits conclusions to ModelView. These checks do not prove all inputs causal.
metric_definitions.export_parity: Actual trial predict.py versus ModelView, with identical weights, category route, full prefix, truncation and fixed candidates. Null/unavailable if the export, route or matching checkpoint is absent. Public exported prediction is singleton-only; batched ModelView parity is checked separately.
metric_definitions.training_prefix_sensitivity: Each vector is [target rank, target-minus-best-negative margin, HR@10]. Positive rank delta is worse; positive margin/hit delta is better. Edited minus unchanged, except recent_minus_older_delete. Fixed 100-item pools and target-independent seeded item tie order. Prefix deltas average within user, then equally across users of this category. All/repeated/novel strata use original-prefix target repetition. Intervals resample paired users 10000 times and exclude training-seed/candidate-sampling uncertainty. Single-user intervals are degenerate. These are in-sample sensitivity estimates, not preferences or validation improvements.
metric_definitions.training_prefix_count: Eligible prefixes after fixed user/target-position caps and unique-negative checks; no outcome-dependent selection.
metric_definitions.repeated_target_prefixes: Eligible prefixes whose target occurred earlier in the original prefix; earlier occurrences are retained.
metric_definitions.novel_target_prefixes: Eligible prefixes whose target did not occur earlier; interpret alongside total coverage.
metric_definitions.exclusions: Counts of unavailable histories, candidate pools or interventions. An unavailable intervention does not remove other eligible paired conditions.
metric_definitions.four_category_macro: Unavailable within a single-category invocation. A macro estimate requires equally weighting all four category means; missing categories must not be reweighted.
metric_definitions.manifest: Trial-local JSON recording predeclared caps, seeds, candidates, event indices, dependency offsets, edit matching, coverage and exclusions. Transition support is only an in-sample coherence proxy. Reviews, ratings, item categories, prices, stores and simulator traits are not used.
